camel_example: aliyun antiddos-public DescribeDdosThreshold --region cn-hangzhou --DdosRegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DdosType defense --InstanceType ecs --InstanceIds.1 'i-bp10bclrt56fblts0000' --version 2017-05-18 --method POST --force
description_en: Retrieves the details of the DDoS mitigation thresholds or traffic scrubbing thresholds for specified assets. The assets can be elastic IP addresses (EIPs). The assets can also be Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances or Server Load Balancer (SLB) instances that are assigned public IP addresses
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号下指定公网IP资产（云服务器ECS实例、负载均衡SLB实例、弹性公网IP实例）的DDoS防护阈值或流量清洗阈值详情
kebab_example: aliyun antiddos-public describe-ddos-threshold --ddos-region-id cn-hangzhou --ddos-type defense --instance-type ecs --instance-ids i-bp10bclrt56fblts0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDdosThreshold

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the asset.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html查询所有地域ID
parameters.name: ddos_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the threshold. Valid values:

defense: traffic scrubbing threshold

blackhole: DDoS mitigation threshold
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的阈值类型。取值：

defense：表示查询流量清洗阈值。
blackhole：表示查询DDoS防护阈值
parameters.name: ddos_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the asset that is assigned a public IP address. Valid values:

ecs: ECS instances.

slb: SLB instances.

eip: EIPs.

ipv6: IPv6 gateways.

swas: simple application servers.

waf: Web Application Firewall (WAF) instances of the Exclusive edition.

ga_basic: Global Accelerator (GA) instances
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产的实例类型。取值：

ecs：表示查询云服务器ECS实例。
slb：表示查询负载均衡SLB实例。
eip：表示查询弹性公网IP实例。
ipv6：表示查询IPv6网关公网实例。
swas：表示查询轻量服务器公网实例。
waf：表示查询Web应用防火墙独享实例。
ga_basic：表示查询全球加速公网实例
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of asset N to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的公网IP资产的实例ID列表
parameters.name: instance_ids

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Threshold.description_en: An array that consists of the details of the threshold
Threshold.description_zh: 公网IP资产的阈值详情列表

items.description_zh: 公网IP资产的阈值详情列表

Bps.description_en:
If the value of the DdosType parameter is defense, the Bps parameter indicates the current traffic scrubbing threshold. Unit: Mbit/s.

If the value of the DdosType parameter is blackhole, the Bps parameter indicates the basic protection threshold. Unit: Mbit/s
Bps.description_zh:
DdosType为defense（表示查询流量清洗阈值）时，表示当前流量清洗阈值。单位：Mbps。

DdosType为blackhole（表示查询DDoS防护阈值）时，表示当前DDoS基础防护阈值。单位：Mbps

DdosType.description_en:
The type of the threshold. Valid values:

defense: traffic scrubbing threshold

blackhole: DDoS mitigation threshold
DdosType.description_zh:
阈值类型。取值：

defense：表示流量清洗阈值。
blackhole：表示DDoS防护阈值

ElasticBps.description_en:
The burstable protection threshold (the maximum DDoS mitigation threshold). Unit: Mbit/s.

This parameter is returned only when the value of the DdosType parameter is blackhole
ElasticBps.description_zh:
DDoS弹性防护阈值（即最大DDoS防护阈值）。单位：Mbps。

只有当DdosType为blackhole（表示查询DDoS防护阈值）时，才会返回该参数

InternetIp.description_en: The IP address of the asset

IsAuto.description_en:
Indicates whether the threshold is automatically adjusted. Valid values:

true: The scrubbing thresholds are automatically adjusted based on the traffic load on the asset.

false: The scrubbing thresholds are not automatically adjusted. You must manually specify the scrubbing thresholds
IsAuto.description_zh:
是否为系统默认阈值。取值：

true：表示是，即由DDoS防护服务根据云服务器的流量负载，动态调整清洗阈值。
false：表示否，即由您手动设置清洗阈值

MaxBps.description_en: The maximum traffic scrubbing threshold. Unit: Mbit/s
MaxBps.description_zh: 最大流量清洗阈值。单位：Mbps

MaxPps.description_en: The maximum packet scrubbing threshold. Unit: pps
MaxPps.description_zh: 最大报文数量清洗阈值。单位：pps

Pps.description_en:
The packet scrubbing threshold. Unit: pps.

This parameter is returned only when the value of the DdosType parameter is defense
Pps.description_zh:
当前报文数量清洗阈值。单位：pps。

只有当DdosType为defense（表示查询流量清洗阈值）时，才会返回该参数
